conductivity_source: Huber, Thermal Conductivity of Gases, NIST table, 300 K
conductivity_note: Air 0.0264 W/(m K) at 100 kPa; argon 0.0177 W/(m K), dilute limit. 300 K values held constant even though T0=293.15 K. Phenomenological sensitivity, not high-T properties.
gas_inventory_note: n fixed by equilibrium for each T0; same n for air and argon at equal initial state; molar mass affects mass density, not the number of moles.
eta_note: Uncalibrated decade sensitivity around geometry estimate eta=1.
interpolation: New C1 cubic Hermite R(t), nodal slopes=stored U; U(t)=dR/dt; event-aware CSV primary, accepted nodes and thinned exports are resolution checks; no extrapolation.
